pages.text: The alpha of the kennels, sire of every frostmaw, curled in his den past the Drowned Lady's cistern. He does not charge - he circles, snaps and leaps. The third bite comes later than the first two.

When a leap misses, his jaws stick in the ice - strike then. His breath and fangs leave rime in you; full, it freezes you where you stand. At half health he brings down a blizzard: listen for the growl.

He rises on his hind legs and rakes with the fore paws - right, then left, wide. When he brings both down on the floor, it splits in a line and ice grows out of it: step out of the line sideways, do not run along it. When he shakes himself like a hound out of water, the ice of his mane comes down into rings on the floor.
His pack comes out of the dark five times: at the start, and in greater numbers after.
